builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Nunu & Willump: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A roaming engage tank who turns snowball momentum into layered control and uses Consume for sustain or objective securing. Compare Q recovery and snowball/R delivery. Maximum R channel is not guaranteed; record interruption, jungle objective access and whether AP loss of defenses prevents casting. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
builds.summary: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Nunu & Willump: Compare Q recovery and snowball/R delivery. Maximum R channel is not guaranteed; record interruption, jungle objective access and whether AP loss of defenses prevents casting.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Nunu & Willump's stated kit question: Compare Q recovery and snowball/R delivery. Maximum R channel is not guaranteed; record interruption, jungle objective access and whether AP loss of defenses prevents casting.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
Nunu and Willump create a snowball that grows in size and speed as they roll it. They turn slower while rolling it, but can increase turning speed by holding the turn.

The snowball does between [(180 / 225 / 270 / 315 / 360 + (1.5) × AP) × (0.333)] and [180 / 225 / 270 / 315 / 360 + (1.5) × AP] magic damage, and Knocks Up for between [0.5] and [0.5 + 0.75] seconds when it collides with a champion, large monster or wall. These values scale up with distance rolled.

Nunu and Willump can Recast to let the snowball go early.

When Nunu and Willump deal damage to champions, large jungle monsters, or structures, they and a nearby ally gain [20]% Attack Speed and [10]% Move Speed for 4 seconds.

Willump's Attacks deal an additional [(0.3) × AD] physical damage to other nearby enemies while he has this buff.

Nunu throws three snowballs, dealing [15 / 22.5 / 30 / 37.5 / 45 + (0.12) × AP] magic damage per snowball and Slowing enemies hit by all three by [(-0.3 / -0.35 / -0.4 / -0.45 / -0.5) × -100]% for [1] second. Nunu can Recast this up to twice more.

After [3] seconds, Nunu Roots all nearby enemies that had been Slowed by the snowballs for [characterLevelInterpolation(0.5 → 1.5; raw flags preserved)] seconds and deals an additional [20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.

Nunu and Willump channel a powerful blizzard for up to [3] seconds. Enemies inside are Slowed by [50]%, increasing to [95]% over the duration. Nunu and Willump also gain [65 / 75 / 85 + (0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (1.5) × AP] Shield for the duration before decaying over [3] seconds afterwards.

When the blizzard ends, it detonates, dealing up to [625 / 925 / 1275 + (3) × AP] magic damage based on channel time. Nunu and Willump can Recast to end the blizzard early.

Nunu asks Willump to take a bite of an enemy, dealing [400 / 600 / 800 / 1000 / 1200] true damage and restoring [65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.9) × AP] Health when used against a minion or jungle monster. Against a champion, it instead deals [60 / 100 / 140 / 180 / 220 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and restores [(65 / 95 / 125 / 155 / 185 + (0.1) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2] + (0.9) × AP) × (0.6)] Health.

The healing is increased by [50]% when Nunu and Willump are below [50]% Health.
